headline: Original effects artwork restored without adjacent-sprite bleed

changes.title: Four original effects sprites corrected by visual comparison
changes.detail: Sparkle Burst, Match Burst, Shell Ring and Confetti were re-isolated from the preserved source atlas, inspected on checkerboard and repaired without changing their game identifiers or other artwork.

changes.title: Source-backed image contracts and visual review gate
changes.detail: Updated the protected sprite hashes and source coordinates, and added visual review evidence plus tests that keep rejected overlapping effects out of live replacements.
